name: Villanueva de los Castillejos (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, green, white and red with a broad central green stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de los Castillejos (a palm tree and castles on white).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de los Castillejos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva de los Castillejos arms — palm tree and castles on white
